# Fund units bought for 100.00 CAD, of a commodity whose full name is empty.
#
# What this fixture produces: one CAD transaction, the bank -100.00 against
# 10.000 units of FUND:NONAME, whose commodity has an empty full name.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_beancount_export_of_a_commodity_with_no_full_name.py.
2026-01-01 commodity NONAME
	mnemonic: "NONAME"
	fullname: ""
	namespace: "FUND"
	fraction: 1000
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Fund
	type: Mutual Fund
	commodity.namespace: "FUND"
	commodity.mnemonic: "NONAME"
2026-03-01 * "Fund units of a commodity with no full name"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank -100.00 CAD
	Assets:Fund 10.000 NONAME
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "NONAME"
		share_price: "10"
		value: "100.00"
